E4Plus1.uk.description: Mangia Mangia (Part 2/2): Gordon returns to Colorado to conclude his attempt to help an Italian restaurant. Can he work his magic on a menu that relies on a microwave? (S7 Ep4) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: DKNY: Adam visits Dave Kim at NYU to celebrate Halloween. Geoff's fear of Beverly taking over baby care duties turns into a jump-scare-filled comedic thriller. (S10 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Rhinestones and Roses: Beverly embraces her new life as a grandmother while trying to stay young at heart, and Adam gets a job while he waits to start at NYU. (S10 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Yard Sale: Jay and Gloria hold a yard sale for Manny and Luke's school charity fundraiser. Manny finds an old trunk that hides a secret that Gloria wants to keep under wraps. (S4 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Arrested: Haley gets arrested for underage drinking, so Phil, Claire - and their lawyer - head to the police station. Cameron looks after Alex and Luke, who get into crazy mishaps. (S4 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: The final dinner party is upon us, and one couple are on the brink after the tumult of meeting their alternate matches. (S13 Ep36)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
E4Plus1.uk.description: A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister that features a variety of cats doing strange things, some soldiers stuck in the sand and a dog balancing on a rope.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Zayna Flaming Grill (Part 1/2): Gordon makes the first of two visits to Zayna Flaming Grill, a Mediterranean restaurant in Redondo Beach owned by Faye and her niece Brenda. (S7 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The City of New York vs. Homer Simpson: Homer must pluck up the courage to return to New York after Barney leaves his car there on a drunken binge. (S9 Ep1/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Principal and the Pauper: The real Seymour Skinner (Martin Sheen) returns to Springfield, revealing that Principal Skinner is an impostor whose real name is Armin Tamzarian. (S9 Ep2/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Future Dunphys: When Phil takes Claire to the hospital for her angiogram, they meet a family who are basically their future selves. They're not sure they like what they see. (S4 Ep19)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Flip Flop: Phil is confident that he can sell Claire and Cam's renovated house, but when it proves harder than he thought, he resorts to desperate measures. (S4 Ep20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: The final dinner party is upon us, and one couple are on the brink after the tumult of meeting their alternate matches. (S13 Ep36)

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Can two content creators, an adventure mermaid and a Sicilian chef find love? And Shrish returns, for cat chat, banter, bonding and plenty of spicy margaritas with James. (S22 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: All Singing, All Dancing: The Simpsons remember all the great songs from their eventful lives after renting the movie Paint Your Wagon. With the guest voice of George Harrison. (S9 Ep11/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Bart Carny: Homer and Bart start working at the fairground, but because of Homer's stupidity, a fair worker and his son lose their jobs. So they steal the Simpsons' house. (S9 Ep12/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Family and friends gather for Rex and Ste's pre-wedding dinner, but will a lovelorn Ro put a stop to it? Elsewhere, Frankie wants to come clean to Caleb.

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Married at First Sight
E4Plus1.uk.description: Australia - Brand new series: The couples face Final Vows and the ultimate choice: are they taking their love into the real world or throwing the last three months in the bin? (S13 Ep37)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Celebs Go Dating
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Lucinda Light has high hopes for her seaside date. Dr Tara gives Coleen Nolan some naughty toys. Professor Green and wingman James head off on a double date. (Ep6/20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Made in Chelsea
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Can Jazz and Inga really be just friends? Chuggs and Zeyno's fling comes at the expense of friendships. And Sam Vanderpump launches an organ donation campaign. (S31 Ep10)
